title: Due-Back Dates, Late Return and Uncleaned Return Charges by Usage Type (Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program)
content:
Fine Arts return notice. Every instrument loaned under the Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program has a due-back date for its fee period. The figures below are the due-back dates and the return-related charges and periods for each usage type.

| Usage type | Due-back date for the fee period | Late fee per calendar day after the due-back date (USD) | Maximum late fee per checkout (USD) | Calendar days after the due-back date after which an unreturned instrument is treated as lost (due-back date is day 0) | Calendar days after the last day of attendance within which the instrument must be returned when the student withdraws | Fee for a return without the required cleaning or with personal items left in the case (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Percussion Equipment Usage | May 21 | 2.00 | 40.00 | 30 | 5 | 25.00 |
| Woodwind Instrument Usage | May 21 | 2.00 | 40.00 | 30 | 5 | 25.00 |
| Brass Instrument Usage | May 21 | 2.00 | 40.00 | 30 | 5 | 25.00 |
| Orchestra String Instrument Usage | May 21 | 2.00 | 40.00 | 30 | 5 | 25.00 |
| Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass) | May 21 | 2.00 | 40.00 | 30 | 5 | 25.00 |
| Summer Instrument Checkout | August 7 | 2.00 | 40.00 | 30 | 5 | 25.00 |

## Notes to the notice

- The five school-year usage types share the due-back date of May 21; Summer Instrument Checkout is due back on August 7.
- The late fee of 2.00 per calendar day reaches the maximum of 40.00 per checkout at 20 calendar days late; no checkout is charged a late fee above 40.00.
- The presumed-lost period of 30 calendar days is counted from the due-back date as day 0.
- The withdrawal return period of 5 calendar days is counted after the student's last day of attendance.

## Hypothetical late-fee figures under this notice

Illustrative inputs only, each a single checkout under one of the six usage types:

| Calendar days late | Late fee per day multiplied by days late | Late fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2.00 | 2.00 |
| 7 | 14.00 | 14.00 |
| 20 | 40.00 | 40.00 |
| 26 | 52.00 | 40.00 |
